title: add-benchmark-lab-adaptive-batching-reporting-pipeline-v71
author: Riley Chen
release_notes: Adds adaptive-batching workload runners and reporting pipeline v71. Improves throughput/latency tracking and adds baseline profiling artifacts. No customer-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: we observed variance in per-request latency under mixed workloads when runtime adaptive batching heuristics changed. This PR adds representative workload runners, profiling baselines, and a reporting pipeline to make adaptive-batching performance regressions visible in the benchmark lab dashboards.

What this PR does: adds a new suite of workload runners that exercise the runtime's adaptive batching logic across variable sequence-length mixes; emits detailed per-request latency histograms, token/sec, batch size distribution, and KV-cache hit metrics; records profiling baselines for cold-start and steady-state for a set of representative models; wires a lightweight reporting pipeline that validates, aggregates, and uploads artifacts to the benchmark lab reporting bucket and updates the reporting schema v3 -> v4. The pipeline includes minimal dedup rules, S3 ingestion, and a transformer that calculates p50/p90/p99 for both per-request latency and per-token latency.

Why now: ENG-4312 introduced improved adaptive batching heuristics; we need continuous profiling to detect regressions and measure trade-offs for latency-sensitive routes. This pipeline lets us collect stable baselines for A/B comparisons and feeds the dashboard used in weekly perf reviews.

Checklist:
- [x] workload runners for mixed-sequence workloads
- [x] profiling baseline recorder (cold + warm)
- [x] reporting pipeline (validator + aggregator + uploader)
- [x] dashboard schema bump and docs snippet
- [x] unit + integration tests for pipeline steps
- [x] lightweight synthetic load generator for CI smoke tests

Summary of changes: added benchmark-lab/runners/adaptive_batching/* (new workload runners), benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/v71/* (new baseline artifacts and recorder), benchmark-lab/reporting/pipeline/v4/* (validator, aggregator, uploader), benchmark-lab/tests/integration/test_reporting_pipeline.py (integration smoke tests), docs/benchmark-lab/adaptive-batching.md (usage and interpretation).

Notes: pipeline v4 keeps backward compat with v3 artifacts; when running locally use --schema v4 flag. The reporter will drop metrics that do not meet the minimum sample size and annotate results with run_id and runner_config. This PR does not change runtime code paths, only tests, runners, and reporting infra.

CI: one flaky integration test (test_reporting_pipeline::test_s3_upload) failed on first run due to transient S3 eventual consistency; retried and passed. See CI checks for details.

Related: references ENG-4312, ENG-5120, and previous PRs pr-275432 and pr-278912 which added earlier adaptive batching experiments.

Merge notes: squash-and-merge; kept commits clean and documented.
